- What to use:
  - The six face intersections yield six chord lengths L1..L6:
    - x = +A: line in yz-plane: q y + r z = d - p A
    - x = -A: q y + r z = d + p A
    - y = +B: p x + r z = d - q B
    - y = -B: p x + r z = d + q B
    - z = +C: p x + q y = d - r C
    - z = -C: p x + q y = d + r C

- Practical notes:

PlanP: purely algebraic identifiability route (description)
- Unknowns to determine:
  - A, B, C > 0: half-dimensions of the prism along x, y, z (faces at x = ±A, y = ±B, z = ±C).
  - p, q, r: components of the unit normal n to the cutting plane, with p^2 + q^2 + r^2 = 1.
  - d: plane offset in p x + q y + r z = d; the distance from the center to the plane is |d|.
- Geometry of intersections:
  - The plane p x + q y + r z = d intersects each face in a line.
  - On x = +A: the line in (y,z) is q y + r z = d - p A, within y ∈ [-B,B], z ∈ [-C,C]; the length of this segment is L1.
  - On x = -A: q y + r z = d + p A; length L2 within the same bounds for y,z.
  - On y = +B: p x + r z = d - q B; length L3 within x ∈ [-A,A], z ∈ [-C,C].
  - On y = -B: p x + r z = d + q B; length L4.
  - On z = +C: p x + q y = d - r C; length L5 within x ∈ [-A,A], y ∈ [-B,B].
  - On z = -C: p x + q y = d + r C; length L6.
- Algebraic plan:
  - Express L1,…,L6 as explicit functions of (A,B,C,p,q,r,d). Each Li is the length of the intersection of a line with a rectangle, which is a manageable piecewise formula depending on where the line hits the rectangle boundaries.
  - Set up the system Li = s_i for i = 1,…,6 with s_i being the given edge lengths (45,66,63,55,54,77 in that order).
  - Add the normalization constraint p^2 + q^2 + r^2 = 1.
  - Solve the resulting nonlinear algebraic system for the seven unknowns (A,B,C,p,q,r,d). The system has seven equations for seven unknowns.
  - The distance from the center to the plane is |d| (since the center is at the origin).
- Practical approach:
  - This is a purely algebraic identifiability problem. It’s natural to attempt a direct nonlinear solver (or a symbolic elimination attempt if feasible) with careful handling of the piecewise Li functions.
  - To improve robustness, use multiple random initial guesses and ensure positivity of A,B,C, plus enforce p^2+q^2+r^2=1 (normalize (p,q,r) after any guess).
